# Real Estate Institute of Queensland (REIQ)

> > Queensland's peak real estate industry body providing member services, compliance guidance, training programs, and advocacy for property professionals.

REIQ serves real estate agents, property managers, and industry professionals across Queensland with legal support from Carter Newell Lawyers, CPD training, dispute resolution, and resources covering regulatory compliance including QCAT decisions, trust account management, and fire safety legislation. Led by CEO Antonia Mercorella, REIQ offers the Realworks platform, Awards for Excellence, and educational content through Prop IQ.

## Key Topics

- Queensland real estate regulation
- QCAT (Queensland Civil and Administrative Tribunal)
- Office of Fair Trading (OFT)
- Property management compliance
- Trust account requirements
- Fire and Emergency Services (Domestic Smoke Alarms) Amendment Act 2016
- Real estate training and licensing
- Carter Newell Lawyers legal support
- Realworks platform
- REIQ Awards for Excellence
- Agent disciplinary proceedings
- Smoke alarm legislation compliance
- Real estate career pathways
- Member services and CPD
- Queensland property buying guidance

## Member Services & Resources

- [Member Services](https://www.reiq.com/membership/services): Exclusive REIQ member support: legal advice, CPD, dispute resolution
- [Prop IQ](https://www.reiq.com/resources/prop-iq): REIQ's video education series for Queensland property buyers and sellers
- [Real Estate Jobs Board - Submit a Job Ad](https://www.reiq.com/resources/real-estate-jobs-board/submit-a-job-ad): Post real estate job ads on REIQ Jobs Board for member recruitment
- [A BDM's guide to winning an Award for Excellence](https://www.reiq.com/articles/membership/a-bdms-guide-to-winning-an-award-for-excellence): Guide for BDMs and property managers to win REIQ Awards for Excellence
- [Not all agents are the same](https://www.reiq.com/articles/membership/not-all-agents-are-the-same): Consumer guide to selecting qualified REIQ member agents in Queensland

## Training & Career Development

- [Real Estate Career Paths](https://www.reiq.com/training/real-estate-career-paths): Queensland real estate career guidance and licensing pathway information

## Compliance & Regulatory Guidance

- [Queensland's final phase of smoke alarm legislation](https://www.reiq.com/articles/agency-practice/queenslands-final-phase-of-smoke-alarm-legislation-are-you-ready): 2027 Queensland smoke alarm deadline guide for rental property compliance
- [Complying with the Fire and Emergency Services (domestic smoke alarms) Amendment Act 2016](https://www.reiq.com/articles/news/complying-with-the-fire-and-emergency-services-domestic-smoke-alarms-amendment-act-2016): Queensland smoke alarm compliance guide for property owners and managers
- [Agent and agency fined for trust account breaches](https://www.reiq.com/articles/agency-practice/agent-and-agency-fined-for-trust-account-breaches): Agent fined $15K+ for trust account breaches; QCAT disqualification case
- [The fine line between marketing and privacy](https://www.reiq.com/articles/news/the-fine-line-between-marketing-and-privacy): Balancing real estate marketing with privacy compliance and data regulations
- [Read the signs: Council requirements for real estate signage](https://www.reiq.com/articles/agency-practice/read-the-signs-considering-local-council-requirements-for-real-estate-signage): Queensland council signage requirements and compliance for real estate agents
